description: A Java class implementing a message mapper for the Ditto Protocol, handling JSON serialization/deserialization of messages and headers.

classes.name: DittoMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class implementing message mapping for the Ditto Protocol, converting between ExternalMessage and Adaptable objects.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage message)
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage containing JSON payload into a list with a single Adaptable object, merging headers.

methods.name: map (Adaptable adaptable)
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into a list with a single ExternalMessage, setting headers and topic path.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns default JSON options for the message mapper.

methods.name: extractPayloadAsString
methods.description: Extracts the message payload as a String from ExternalMessage, handling text and byte messages.

methods.name: determineCharset
methods.description: Determines the Charset from message headers.
